about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: The initial image literal for FD CUSTFILE-REC in Cbcus01cService is dead because 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT executes READ into CUSTOMER-RECORD before any buffer read.
The trailing bytes of the initial image for FD CUSTFILE-REC are dead because reading CUSTFILE completely repopulates the record buffer before access.
The initial image literal for CUSTOMER-RECORD is dead because 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT unconditionally overwrites CUSTOMER-RECORD via READ CUSTFILE INTO CUSTOMER-RECORD prior to DISPLAY.
The second segment of the initial image literal for CUSTOMER-RECORD is overwritten during sequential reads before any display or inspection.
The initial image literal for CUSTFILE-STATUS is dead because 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN executes OPEN INPUT CUSTFILE which populates CUSTFILE-STATUS before any condition check.
The initial image literal for IO-STATUS is dead because IO-STATUS is only read in Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, which is always preceded by a MOVE to IO-STATUS.
The initial image literal for TWO-BYTES-BINARY is dead because Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS explicitly executes Cobol.move(0, TWO_BYTES_BINARY) before use.
The initial image literal for IO-STATUS-04 is dead because Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS overwrites all four characters of IO-STATUS-04 before displaying it.

survivors.before: private final Field f41_GG_RETURN_CODE = Field.binary(s_GG_RETURN_CODE, 0, 4, 0, true, false);
survivors.after: private final Field f41_GG_RETURN_CODE = Field.binary(s_GG_RETURN_CODE, 0, 4, 1, true, false);
survivors.reason: f41_GG_RETURN_CODE is only read from s_GG_RETURN_CODE whose initial image is all zeros and never written; any binary window read evaluates to 0.

survivors.before: return Cobol.num(Field.zoned(s, 0, 9, 0, false, false, false), CS).intValue();
survivors.after: return Cobol.num(Field.zoned(s, 1, 9, 0, false, false, false), CS).intValue();
survivors.reason: The repository id_CustomerRecord helper is registered for findById queries, but CBCUS01C executes sequential batch reads via findAll, so findById is never invoked.
The initialState arraycopy for FD CUSTFILE-REC is dead because 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT populates the buffer from CUSTFILE before any read.
The initialState arraycopy for CUSTOMER-RECORD is dead because 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT unconditionally reads the next sequential record into CUSTOMER-RECORD before DISPLAY.
The initialState arraycopy for CUSTFILE-STATUS is dead because 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN immediately issues OPEN INPUT CUSTFILE which sets CUSTFILE-STATUS.
The initialState arraycopy for IO-STATUS is dead because IO-STATUS is only read in Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, which is always preceded by MOVE to IO-STATUS.
The initialState arraycopy for IO-STATUS-04 is dead because Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS explicitly formats all four bytes before DISPLAY.
In initialState(), zeroing f37_APPL_RESULT is dead because 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN unconditionally assigns 8L to APPL-RESULT before any condition check.
Every read of f39_ABCODE in Z-ABEND-PROGRAM follows an unconditional store of 999 into ABCODE, so the initial zero store is never read.
runProgram() is an uncalled standalone method never invoked during batch execution, which enters exclusively via runBatch.
In the uncalled standalone runProgram() entry point, clearing performDepth is never reached because batch execution runs via runBatch.
The PERFORM statement in runProgram() is unreachable because CBCUS01C runs in batch mode through runBatch and never invokes runProgram().

survivors.reason: The key offset parameter in DetFiles.Indexed is only used for index key extraction on random access, but CBCUS01C reads CUSTFILE sequentially via findAll.
Initializing performThru array size to 65 instead of 64 has no observable effect because call stack depth in CBCUS01C never exceeds 2.
PerformExit is never thrown in CBCUS01C because all PERFORM calls execute single paragraphs, so constructor super-call details are never observed.
The performThru array expansion in perform() is guarded by mine == performThru.length (capacity 64), which is never reached since perform depth never exceeds 2.
Array reallocation in perform() is never reached because the call stack depth in CBCUS01C never approaches the initial 64-element capacity of performThru.
The loop condition d < 0 in perform() is never reached because all PERFORM calls in CBCUS01C execute paragraphs that exit without active thru ranges.
In perform(), the increment d++ in the loop tail is never executed because paragraph returns in CBCUS01C never satisfy i != thru.
In perform(), the reverse search loop tail is entered only when a paragraph returns with i != thru, which no PERFORM statement in CBCUS01C does.
The perform loop tail condition d > 0 is never evaluated because CBCUS01C only uses single-paragraph perform invocations where i == thru.
In perform(), inverting the performThru match condition is unreachable because the enclosing loop is never entered when i == thru.
In perform(), testing performThru[d] != i in the search loop is unreachable because CBCUS01C performs are simple single-paragraph invocations.
In perform(), testing next < 6 in the paragraph bounds check is unreachable because CBCUS01C perform statements never return with i != thru.
In perform(), inverting next >= 6 in the paragraph bounds check is unreachable because the loop tail is only entered when i != thru.
In perform(), testing next > 6 is unreachable because the paragraph dispatcher loop tail is never entered for single-paragraph performs.
In perform(), testing e.depth == mine in the PerformExit handler is unreachable because PerformExit is never thrown in CBCUS01C.
In perform(), testing e.depth != mine in the PerformExit catch block is unreachable because PerformExit is never thrown in CBCUS01C.
In the paragraph dispatch switch of perform(), the default arm is unreachable because all paragraph indices in CBCUS01C are between 0 and 5.
f37_APPL_RESULT is set to 0L at the start of paragraph 0, but 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN immediately assigns 8L to APPL-RESULT, so deleting this assignment has no effect.
In 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT, the return value next is ignored by perform(1, 1) because single-paragraph performs exit immediately when i == thru without evaluating next.
In DetFiles.Indexed.open(mode), sequential input datasets ignore the mode string and open in read mode regardless of whether mode is INPUT or XNPUT.
In 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN failure path, APPL-RESULT is already non-zero (8L) so isApplAok() returns false, and subsequent abend halts execution without APPL-RESULT ever being read.
In 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN, paragraph 4 is Z-ABEND-PROGRAM which unconditionally throws CobolAbend.user, so paragraph 5 in the PERFORM range is never reached.
In 9000-CUSTFILE-CLOSE, adding zero versus subtracting zero from BigDecimal constant D8 (8) is an arithmetic identity producing the exact same numeric value 8.
In 9000-CUSTFILE-CLOSE, setting APPL-RESULT to 8 is dead because both arms of the subsequent IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '00' check immediately overwrite APPL-RESULT.
In 9000-CUSTFILE-CLOSE error path, adding zero versus subtracting zero from constant D12 (12) produces identical value 12.
In 9000-CUSTFILE-CLOSE error branch, APPL-RESULT remains non-zero (8) from prior store so isApplAok() evaluates false, and subsequent Z-ABEND-PROGRAM terminates without reading APPL-RESULT.
Every read of f40_TIMING in Z-ABEND-PROGRAM follows an unconditional store of 0 into TIMING, so the initial zero store in Cbcus01cService is never read.
In Z-ABEND-PROGRAM, the routine name string passed to CobolAbend.user is informational and does not alter the abend code 999 or any observable output.
In Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, non-VSAM status values take the else branch where TWO-BYTES-BINARY is never read, and VSAM status codes overwrite the field.
